nodes.roomMessageTrigger: Starts the script when a message is posted in a room. Filter by room, prefix (/ping) or mention.
nodes.roomCommandTrigger: Starts the script when someone runs one of the bot's slash commands. Arguments are validated before the run and arrive typed in options.
nodes.roomInteractionTrigger: Starts the script when a person presses a button or picks an option of a message this bot posted.
nodes.roomReactionTrigger: Starts the script when a person adds a reaction in a room the bot can see. Reactions by bots never start anything.
nodes.roomEditedTrigger: Starts the script when a person edits a message the bot can see.
nodes.roomDeletedTrigger: Starts the script when a message is deleted in a room the bot can see.
nodes.roomMemberJoinTrigger: Starts the script when a person joins the workspace. Needs the room where the bot acts.
nodes.roomScheduledTrigger: Starts the script on a schedule: every N minutes, or daily at a UTC time.
nodes.roomSendMessage: Posts a message in a room as the bot: text and/or rich blocks, optionally buttons and selects.
nodes.roomReply: Replies to a message as the bot (by default the one that triggered the script). Can go in its thread or be private to one person.
nodes.roomEditMessage: Edits a message this bot wrote (by default the last one it posted in this run).
nodes.roomDeleteMessage: Deletes a message this bot wrote (by default the last one it posted in this run).
nodes.roomPinMessage: Pins or unpins a message through the room's pin system, with an optional expiry.
nodes.roomCreateThread: Opens a thread on a message by posting its first reply.
nodes.roomReact: Adds an emoji reaction as the bot. Defaults to the message that triggered the script.
nodes.roomUnreact: Removes the bot's own reaction from a message.
nodes.roomSendDm: Writes a direct message to a person (by default the one who started the run). Limited per hour and audited.
nodes.roomRespondInteraction: Answers a button or select press: update the message, answer only that person, or post a new message.
nodes.teamAssignSelfRole: Gives the person who reacted or pressed a button a self-assignable role. Only from a Reaction or Interaction trigger; the bot needs bots.assign_roles.
nodes.teamRemoveSelfRole: Takes a self-assignable role away from the person who reacted or pressed a button. Same rules as giving it.
nodes.modMuteMember: Mutes a member with the rights and hierarchy of the moderator who pressed the button (not the bot). Only from an Interaction trigger; the id of the button must contain the user id (mod:mute:<id>).
nodes.modKickMember: Removes a member from the workspace as the moderator who pressed the button. Only from an Interaction trigger; the button id must contain the user id.
nodes.roomCountRecent: Counts the recent messages of a person in a room (deleted ones included) and stores the number in the item.
nodes.teamMemberInfo: Reads whether a person is a member, new, exempt (by roles), admin or owner, and puts it in the item as member.
nodes.condTextMatchList: Checks a text against a list of words. Two outputs: match_true and match_false.
nodes.transCountMatches: Counts the mentions, links or custom pattern matches of a text and stores the number.

manual.description: Emits items when you run the script manually from Killio-Scripts.

aiResponse.description: Runs the Killio agent on the incoming data plus an optional extra prompt and outputs clean text.

whatsappPersonalSend.description: Sends a message via your paired personal WhatsApp. Bind fields like {number} and {aiResponse}.

roomMessage.description: Starts the bot script when a message is posted in a room. Filters: room, command prefix and mention. Emits text, command, args, roomId, messageId and authorName.

roomSend.description: Posts a message in a room as the bot that owns the script. Replies in the triggering room by default. Supports {fields} and {{expressions}}.

roomReact.description: Adds an emoji reaction as the bot, by default on the message that triggered the script.
